en.headline: Hang Seng Index closes 3.03 percent lower at 22934.68
en.dek: The benchmark fell 717 points as the Hang Seng Tech Index dropped 5.03 percent, with Alibaba, Meituan and Xiaomi among the heaviest blue-chip losers.
body: Hong Kong stocks closed sharply lower on Thursday, with the Hang Seng Index finishing at 22934.68, down 717.19 points or 3.03 percent from the previous close.

The Hang Seng China Enterprises Index fell 3.2 percent to 7689.19, while the Hang Seng Tech Index plunged 5.03 percent to 3793.93. Full-day turnover on the main board reached HK$256.05 billion, according to exchange data.

Technology and related shares led the decline. Alibaba Group closed down more than 6 percent, Meituan more than 4 percent, and Xiaomi more than 3 percent. Tencent Holdings fell 2.89 percent to HK$382.40. Local property stocks also weakened, with Sun Hung Kai Properties down 3.07 percent.

The drop extended a morning slide that had already taken the index below 23000 by midday. Market participants cited ongoing concerns over the pace of AI-related investment and broader regional weakness in technology shares.

zh.headline: 恒生指數收報22934.68點 全日跌3.03%
zh.dek: 恒指收跌717點，恒生科技指數挫5.03%，阿里巴巴、美團及小米等藍籌科技股領跌。
body: 港股周四大幅低收，恒生指數收報22934.68點，較上日收市跌717.19點，跌幅3.03%。
恒生中國企業指數下跌3.2%至7689.19點，恒生科技指數則大跌5.03%至3793.93點。主板全日成交額達2560.51億元。
科技股成為主要拖累。阿里巴巴集團收跌逾6%，美團跌逾4%，小米跌逾3%。騰訊控股跌2.89%，收報382.4港元。本地地產股亦偏軟，新鴻基地產跌3.07%。
大市延續上午的跌勢，午市已失守23000點關口。市場人士指，對人工智能相關投資節奏的憂慮，以及區內科技股普遍疲弱，繼續壓抑港股氣氛。
